title: CMSIS workspace settings
description: Mirrored active CMSIS solution and persisted target type and target set selections for a workspace.

activeSolution.description: Informational forward-slash path to the active csolution file, relative to the directory containing cmsis.json. The extension does not use this property to restore the active solution.

activeTarget.description: Informational active target in target-type or target-type@target-set form. The extension uses targetSet as the persisted selection.

targetSet.description: Persisted target selections keyed by workspace-relative csolution name without the .csolution.yml extension.

force-update-rte.description: One-shot request to update the runtime environment when the solution is next initialized. The extension removes this property after reading it.

target-selection.description: The active target type and optional selected target-set indexes for one solution.

activeTargetType.description: Name of the active target type.

additionalProperties.description: Zero-based target-set index keyed by target-type name. Omitted when the target type has no named target set.
